name: Coarse Geometry Searching
aliases: Two-stage optimization with coarse voxel grid
definition: A two-stage optimization process where the first stage efficiently finds the coarse 3D areas of interest (geometry) using a low-resolution voxel grid with view-invariant color, reducing queried points for the fine stage.
summary: Coarse Geometry Searching is a two-stage optimization that uses a dense, low-resolution voxel grid to generate an occupancy mask for pruning, distinguishing itself from static hashing methods.
